name: clinic-appointment-patient-tracker
description: Monorepo root for Clinic Appointment & Patient Tracker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACK,FRONT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:up: podman compose up -d db 2>/dev/null || podman-compose up -d db 2>/dev/null || docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:down: podman compose down 2>/dev/null || podman-compose down 2>/dev/null || docker compose down
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
